notes: Report says 'A total of 126 tests were conducted' (printed p.3); the PSI table has 129 rows.
Fan calibration is used only for blowoff pots it calibrated exactly. Extinction pots (0.27-0.36) are below its lowest calibrated pot (0.5), so those flows are not reconstructed.

panel2_points.method: Flame burning at this Air display reading (cm/s). The flow was then lowered with pot settings below the fan calibration until extinction, so this is NOT the extinction flow
